sections.name: Final Chorus — Bigger, Sung + Rap Layers

lines.text: Maybe there is one deeper law
and the rest falls into line.
when the same law holds its ground.
is the thing we cannot name?
out of reach of what we knew.
We could say it in a sentence—
we just couldn't write it right.
we just couldn't write it down.
and the answer can be found.
on the other side of the screen.
had an answer from the start.
